tools.name: workspace_create
tools.description: Create a private customer workspace. Returns a workspace API token once; save it securely.

tools.name: workspace_token_rotate
tools.description: Rotate a workspace API token. The current token is required; the replacement is shown once and the old token stops working immediately.

tools.name: workspace_revoke
tools.description: Permanently revoke a workspace API token and disable workspace-level operations. This action cannot be undone; existing individual contract and monitor tokens are not revoked.

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List contracts and aggregate usage belonging only to a private workspace. Requires its workspace API token.

tools.name: contract_create
tools.description: Create a private, reusable, versioned data contract for an AI-agent workflow. Returns a one-time access token; store it securely because it cannot be retrieved later.

tools.name: contract_get
tools.description: Retrieve metadata and a published schema version for a private data contract. Requires its access token.

tools.name: contract_publish
tools.description: Publish a new immutable version of an existing private data contract. Older versions remain available for reproducible validation.

tools.name: contract_compare
tools.description: Compare two immutable versions of a private data contract and report added, removed, and changed schema paths. Useful for reviewing upstream API contract changes before publishing or upgrading an agent.

tools.name: contract_history
tools.description: Retrieve recent validation decisions and failure evidence for a private contract. Stores only validation metadata, not customer payloads; the latest 100 events per contract are retained.

tools.name: contract_validate
tools.description: Validate incoming JSON against a stored, versioned data contract. Detects missing, changed, or invalid upstream data before an AI agent uses it. Returns machine-readable pass/fail and evidence.

tools.name: monitor_create
tools.description: Create a private push-monitor endpoint connected to an existing contract. Send each upstream API response to the returned HTTPS endpoint; Zorqelio validates it, records ALLOW/BLOCK evidence, and never stores the submitted payload. The monitor token is shown once.

tools.name: monitor_status
tools.description: Retrieve health and usage counters for a private push monitor. Requires its monitor ID and one-time monitor token.

tools.name: monitor_history
tools.description: Retrieve the recent event timeline for a private monitor, including creation, stale transitions, recovery, blocked checks, and revocation. Requires its monitor ID and one-time monitor token. Event records never contain customer payloads.

tools.name: monitor_revoke
tools.description: Immediately revoke a private push monitor token. Future submissions to its HTTP endpoint are rejected. Requires its monitor ID and monitor token.

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Pretty-print and normalize JSON. Accepts JSON text and returns formatted JSON plus basic statistics.

tools.name: json_diff
tools.description: Compare two JSON documents and return deterministic JSON Pointer paths that were added, removed, or changed.

tools.name: json_to_csv
tools.description: Convert a JSON array of flat objects into CSV with escaped cells and a stable union of columns.

tools.name: json_schema_validate
tools.description: Validate a JSON document against a supplied JSON Schema and return actionable validation errors.

tools.name: data_quality_profile
tools.description: Profile a JSON dataset and report field completeness, nulls, empty values, distinct counts, type distributions, and duplicate rows. Deterministic and local to the request.

tools.name: data_quality_check
tools.description: Run deterministic data-quality rules against one JSON object or up to 10,000 records. Checks required/non-empty fields, types, numeric ranges, allowed values, email/URL formats, and uniqueness. Returns a weighted quality score and actionable row-level issues.

tools.name: quality_policy_get
tools.description: Retrieve a saved private data-quality policy version.

tools.name: quality_policy_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate one explicit saved policy version, persist sanitized results and return ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK. Reuse operationId for an exact retry.

tools.name: quality_policy_history
tools.description: Read recent private evaluations of one saved quality policy.

tools.name: data_normalize
tools.description: Normalize inconsistent JSON records into a predictable structure using explicit source-to-target field mappings and defaults. Deterministic; does not call an AI model.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data_quality_check · Private data: workspace_create, workspace_token_rotate, workspace_revoke, workspace_list, contract_create, contract_get, contract_publish, contract_compare, contract_history, monitor_create, monitor_status, monitor_history, monitor_revoke, json_diff, json_schema_validate, data_quality_check, quality_policy_get, quality_policy_history, data_normalize · Public sink: contract_publish, monitor_create, data_quality_check · Destructive: json_format, data_quality_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data_quality_check · Private data: workspace_create, workspace_token_rotate, workspace_revoke, workspace_list, contract_create, contract_get, contract_publish, contract_compare, contract_history, monitor_create, monitor_status, monitor_history, monitor_revoke, json_diff, json_schema_validate, data_quality_check, quality_policy_get, quality_policy_history, data_normalize · Public sink: contract_publish, monitor_create, data_quality_check · Destructive: json_format, data_quality_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
